boundary: bounded read-only source/output review; not semantic acceptance

cases.source_review: Three collapse-panel segments contain a forging instruction and related structure; one segment is image-only or unsupported for this output.
cases.output_review: The accepted output contains distinct process-start, state-change, visual-signal, and operation events plus local mentions; the unsupported segment is explicitly accounted for.
cases.signal_result: coverage_noncovered is a false-positive review trigger for this bounded read

cases.source_review: Two short collapse-panel segments describe the transformation caused by fire or electro elements and the resulting materials.
cases.output_review: The output retains the transformation event, four local mentions, and separate relations for both resulting states and materials.
cases.signal_result: absence of qualifiers is a false-positive review trigger for this bounded read

cases.source_review: The provider-facing dialogue piece has segment id suffix :p509, but its value has no semantic_stage metadata; this is a cap split, not an explicit stage marker.
cases.output_review: The accepted output preserves the visible dialogue option, speaker mention, and topic.
cases.signal_result: the prior :p substring heuristic would have been a false positive; explicit metadata detection correctly does not flag it

cases.source_review: The map_desc decoded list contains screenshot and location tabs.
cases.output_review: The accepted output contains only map-supported topics corresponding to the record title, NPC display, screenshot, and location tabs; there is no text component in this unit.
cases.signal_result: map-only input is not evidence of a map/text binding problem

limitations: These four controls are a small descriptive check, not a calibrated precision/recall study.
No control establishes semantic acceptance or active Navi/KG eligibility.

The known 507825 point-1 omission is not captured by empty-output, sparse-output, map/text, or validator-rejection signals; explicit stage metadata can only nominate review and does not prove the omission.
